name: honkpad
title: Honkpad
description: Play memes from your Honkpad soundboard, play a random one, or stop the sound.
author: idoo

commands.name: play-meme
commands.title: Play Meme
commands.subtitle: Honkpad
commands.description: Search the memes on your active Honkpad board and play one.

commands.name: random-meme
commands.title: Random Meme
commands.subtitle: Honkpad
commands.description: Play a random meme from your active Honkpad board.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Optional on the same computer. In Honkpad open Settings → Advanced → Stream Deck and HTTP API, copy any URL and paste the part after token=.

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: Port
preferences.description: Honkpad's local port. Leave empty for the default, 7840.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
